map.最大承载 N=剪切强度×面积；许用载荷=最大承载÷安全系数；许用应力=剪切强度÷: Maximum load N = shear strength x area; allowable load = maximum load / safety factor; allowable stress = shear strength / safety factor; estimated tensile load about maximum load x 1.5. Safety factor <2 suits non-critical static loads only, 2-4 general duty, >4 dynamic loads/critical structures.

map.静载非关键可取 <2，一般结构 2~4，动载/冲击/人命相关应 >4: Non-critical static loads can take <2, general structures 2-4, and dynamic/impact/life-safety loads should take >4

map.表面处理、胶层厚度与固化条件对强度影响大，须按工艺规范执行: Surface preparation, adhesive thickness and curing conditions strongly affect strength, so follow the process specification
map.静载非关键可取 <2，一般结构 2~4，动载、冲击或人命相关关键结构应 >4；过: Non-critical static loads can take <2, general structures 2-4, and critical structures subject to dynamic loads, impact or life-safety concerns should take >4; too low risks failure while too high wastes material and adhesive.
map.为什么估算抗拉是最大承载的 1.5 倍？: Why is the estimated tensile load 1.5 times the maximum load?
map.胶层受剪时因应力集中与剥离分量，实际破坏载荷常高于纯剪理论值，1.5 为经验放大: When an adhesive layer is in shear, stress concentration and peel components make the actual failure load usually higher than the pure-shear theoretical value; 1.5 is an empirical amplification factor for estimation only, and formal design should rely on testing.
